partners.mechanism_chain: WNT10A (HGNC:38271) —DISRUPTS→ WNT signaling pathway (GO:0060070); WNT signaling pathway (GO:0060070) —LEADS_TO→ Selective tooth agenesis (HP:0000175); WNT5A (HGNC:12733) —DISRUPTS→ WNT signaling pathway (GO:0060070); WNT signaling pathway (GO:0060070) —LEADS_TO→ Robinow syndrome (HP:0001379).
